_help: Inventory items. sprite is relative to assets/sprites/. kind: key (opens key locks), tool (used on something you can see), part (combines into something), clue (readable), care (given to Chloé: food, water, leash, brush, Gaston), scent (Chloé sniffs it and finds a hidden spot). Names are shown to the player.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.text: A shiny brass key with a sun-shaped bow.

tiny_key.name: tiny key
tiny_key.text: A tiny silver key. It must open something small.

shell_key.name: seashell key
shell_key.text: A key with a little seashell charm. Very Mamie.

old_key.name: old key
old_key.text: An old iron key, whole again.

key_bow.name: key handle
key_bow.text: The ring end of a broken key.

key_blade.name: key blade
key_blade.text: The toothy end of a broken key.

flashlight.name: working flashlight
flashlight.text: It works! Good for dark corners.

screwdriver.name: screwdriver
screwdriver.text: A screwdriver with a coral handle.

magnet.name: magnet
magnet.text: A strong fridge magnet shaped like a lemon.

fishing_magnet.name: magnet on a string
fishing_magnet.text: Perfect for fishing things out of deep places.

torn_photo_right.name: torn photo (right)
torn_photo_right.text: The other half of an old photo.

gaston.name: Gaston the seagull
gaston.text: Chloé's squeaky toy seagull. Very chewed. Very loved.

kibble.name: bag of kibble
kibble.text: Chloé's breakfast. She has opinions about it.

leash.name: Chloé's leash
leash.text: A coral leash. Chloé only goes out the front with it on.

water_jug.name: jug of water
water_jug.text: Fresh water for a thirsty dog.

dog_brush.name: Chloé's brush
dog_brush.text: Chloé pretends to hate being brushed. She doesn't.

mamie_glove.name: Mamie's gardening glove
mamie_glove.text: It still smells of her. Chloé would know that smell anywhere.

henri_scarf.name: Henri's scarf
henri_scarf.text: Henri's old navy scarf. Mamie kept it in her drawer.

margot_teddy.name: Margot's teddy
margot_teddy.text: Margot's old teddy bear, with one ear chewed (not by Margot).
